StatusLIVE EXECUTIVE DASHBOARD
PurposeFounder-level command board for root-cause quality, containment discipline, corrective-action closure, preventive-action verification, recurrence prevention, and supplier release posture on active issue cases.
Source ruleUpdate complaint records, inspection evidence, claims recovery, shipment review logs, release reviews, supplier performance, control integrity, and linked source records first, then refresh this review.
Founder useDecide whether an issue is only contained, genuinely corrected, verified as prevented, or still too weak to return to standard operating posture.
Protection ruleThis dashboard governs CAPA posture only; approved templates, brand assets, and source-record protections stay unchanged.

CAPA Control PostureLink

Control lensCurrent postureFounder readRequired response
Containment qualityCustomer-facing containment is active and commercially useful.The relationship can be protected before root cause is fully proven, but closure language must stay disciplined.Keep containment separate from verified prevention until the evidence pack is complete.
Root-cause confidenceMoisture-exposure pathway is directionally clear, but loading-condition proof is still open.A plausible narrative is not enough for supplier, release, or recurrence decisions.Require traceability, loading, packaging, and comparable-cycle evidence before final root-cause closure.
Corrective actionImmediate correction path is defined and owned.The current case can move, but the system should not treat correction as prevention.Keep corrective actions tied to owner, date, and customer/recovery impact.
Preventive verificationNext-cycle proof remains the critical open gate.Prevention is not real until observed execution shows the weakness did not recur.Require packaging reinforcement, loading evidence, and release sign-off on the next comparable shipment.
Supplier release postureSupplier confidence should remain controlled until verification lands.Normal supplier posture would be premature if CAPA proof is weak.Feed CAPA status into supplier performance, release review, and supply resilience before any relaxation.

CAPA Stage GatesLink

Stage gateRequired evidenceFounder statusStop condition
ContainedCustomer communication, hold or remedy path, owner, and immediate risk boundary are documented.Customer and commercial pressure can be managed.Stop if containment is used as closure language.
Root cause supportedLot path, inspection evidence, shipment conditions, supplier input, and packaging review support one cause path.Root-cause statement can be drafted.Stop if narrative outruns evidence.
Corrective action closedOwner action, due date, completion proof, and customer or recovery impact are recorded.Current issue can move toward closeout.Stop if correction lacks evidence or owner sign-off.
Preventive action verifiedNext comparable shipment or supplier cycle shows revised control worked.CAPA can move toward verified prevention.Stop if verification is theoretical or advisory only.
Standard posture restoredSupplier, release, customer, and profitability records all reflect the verified control improvement.System can return to normal posture.Stop if one linked board still shows unresolved risk.

Escalation and Stop RulesLink

RuleConditionRequired escalationFounder action

Prevention proof stopPreventive action is marked complete without next-cycle execution evidence.Route to supplier performance and shipment release review.Withhold standard supplier or release posture.

Supplier confidence stopSupplier remains at normal posture despite unresolved recurrence risk.Route to supplier performance, supply resilience, and risk register.Tighten supplier release posture or require backup-source action.
